main.description: One followed feed: an RSS, Atom or JSON Feed document by URL, or a standard.site publication by its at:// URI. The source of truth for a reader's follow list. Public feeds only: a URL carrying a credential must not be written here.

url.description: The feed document's URL, or a site.standard.publication record's at:// URI.

title.description: Display title. A reader may override it from feed metadata.

siteUrl.description: The human-facing site the feed belongs to. Readers must not render a non-http(s) value as a link.

folder.description: A community.lexicon.rss.folder record this subscription is filed under. A feed lives in at most one folder.

fetchHint.description: Polling cadence the reader may honour or ignore.

private.description: Reserved. Nothing writes it today; a reader must not change behaviour on it.
